fixes: Basin: concept (sheet-vs-water-2 #6) has a bulky rock pedestal ~0.8 m high and wider than the wall (1.2 m) with a round lipped bowl on top, ~0.6 m diameter, water brim near 0.85 m. The model basin is a tiny glassy teal block of loose shards at ground level inside the wall footprint. Build a 0.8 m x 1.0 m lumpy pedestal with a sunken bowl (rim 5-8 cm) and let it bulge ~0.15 m past the wall face.

Top slot: concept has a narrow stone trough with a thin bright lip, a clear overhang, and a lip that projects ~5 cm so threads detach. Model has a plain flat lintel slab (~0.3 m thick, faceted) with threads starting under it. Replace with a 1.1 m x 0.12 m channel with a 4 cm projecting stone lip and a visible water-filled trough on top.

Threads: opaque white ribbons with hard edges and kinks read as plastic strips. Make them 8-15 mm wide, tapered, near-vertical, spaced irregularly (some paired), starting exactly at the lip and ending in the bowl; thin them to roughly 1/2 the current width so the shader flow has room to read.

Rock face: surface reads as crumpled foil with white hot-spots (sheet.jpg top view is mostly specular blotches). Reduce facet noise amplitude to ~3-5 cm over 20-40 cm cells, add 2-3 ledges/overhangs where threads kink, and keep large planar fall-lines so threads run down the surface instead of floating off it.

Side blocks: the left column of ~8 stacked cubes with a lantern at its foot reads as a pile of boxes. Concept side view shows a coursed ashlar wall (3-4 block widths, staggered joints, 0.25 m course height) against the rock. Stagger joints, vary block widths, and add 1-2 mm joint bevels.
LOD2/3: the rectangle slab is fine at close range but at 66/157 m is a dark speck. Bring the basin pedestal into the LOD2 silhouette (bulge below) so the wider-base shape reads.
library_issues: basalt_wet reads as polished chrome/foil with harsh white specular blotches; roughness too low or normal scale too strong at this size
waterfall material on threads renders opaque flat white; needs emissive/transmissive treatment or a softer tint (runtime shader may overwrite)
summary: Reads as a rock slab with vertical strips and some ashlar on one side, but the concept's bulky basin pedestal and lipped top trough are missing, the rock looks like crumpled foil, and the threads are hard white ribbons. Needs the pedestal/bowl and slot rebuilt and the rock calmed.
